description: This file implements the LocalStore class, which manages database operations such as opening a database, creating tables, setting limits, retrieving entries, and removing entries. It interacts with a DatabaseConnection object and provides methods for database manipulation within the WPEFramework plugin namespace.

classes.name: LocalStore
classes.description: A class that manages local database storage, including opening connections, creating tables, setting limits, and CRUD operations on entries.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Opens a database connection at the specified path, creating the database file if necessary.

methods.name: CreateTable
methods.description: Creates a new table in the database with the specified name.

methods.name: SetLimit
methods.description: Sets the maximum page count limit for the database.

methods.name: GetEntriesCount
methods.description: Retrieves the count and starting ID of entries in a table.

methods.name: GetEntries
methods.description: Retrieves a list of entries from a table starting from a specific index.

methods.name: RemoveEntries
methods.description: Removes entries from a table within a specified ID range.

methods.name: AddEntry
methods.description: Adds a new entry to a specified table.

methods.name: buildGetEventsQuery
methods.description: Constructs an SQL query to retrieve events from a table based on start index and count.
